items.title: US Senate narrowly confirms Trump loyalist Todd Blanche as attorney general

items.title: Saudi, Turkey, Pakistan: Deal for joint support amid regional war
items.standfirst: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey signed a joint defence agreement in Mecca on Friday, aimed at strengthening collective deterrence. Under the pact, an armed attack on any one of the three countries would be considered an attack on all. Simon Moritz tells us more about what’s in the agreement.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
items.standfirst: Pakistan says an attack on any of the three will amount to an attack against all, amid conflict in the Middle East.
